description_en: Modifies the information of a compliance package in a specified account group
description_zh: 修改指定账号组内的合规包信息
kebab_example: aliyun config update-aggregate-compliance-pack --compliance-pack-id cp-fdc8626622af00f90000 --aggregator-id ca-f632626622af00790000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAggregateCompliancePack

parameters.help_en:
The compliance package ID.

For information about how to obtain the compliance package ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

parameters.example: 基于等保2.0三级标准，提供持续检测合规性的建议模板，帮助您提前自检并修复问题，以便快速通过正式检测。
parameters.help_en: The description of the compliance package
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The risk level of the compliance package. Valid values:
1: High risk.
2: Medium risk.
3: Low risk
parameters.help_zh:
合规包的风险等级。取值：
1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险
parameters.name: risk_level

fields.help_en:
The rule ID. Cloud Config adds the existing rule to the current compliance package.

Specify either `ManagedRuleIdentifier` or `ConfigRuleId`. If both parameters are specified, `ConfigRuleId` takes precedence. For information about how to obtain the rule ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
fields.help_zh:
规则ID。配置审计将已有规则加入到当前合规包中。

`ManagedRuleIdentifier`和`ConfigRuleId`二选一，当两个参数都设置时，以`ConfigRuleId`为准确。关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
fields.name: config_rule_id

fields.help_en:
The name of the rule parameter.

The `ParameterName` and `ParameterValue` parameters must be set together or left unset together. If the rule template has parameters without default values, you must set this parameter. For information about how to obtain the parameter name of a rule template, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/261176.html
fields.help_zh:
规则参数名称。

参数`ParameterName`和`ParameterValue`必须同时设置，或同时不设置。如果规则模板存在参数，且无默认取值，则您必须设置该参数。关于如何获取规则模板的参数名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/261176.html
fields.name: parameter_name

fields.help_en:
The value of the rule parameter.

The `ParameterName` and `ParameterValue` parameters must be set together or left unset together. If the rule template has parameters without default values, you must set this parameter. For information about how to obtain the parameter value of a rule template, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/261176.html
fields.help_zh:
规则参数值。

参数`ParameterName`和`ParameterValue`必须同时设置，或同时不设置。如果规则模板存在参数，且无默认取值，则您必须设置该参数。关于如何获取规则模板的参数值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/261176.html
fields.name: parameter_value

fields.example: 弹性公网已绑定到ECS或者NAT实例，非闲置状态，视为“合规”。
fields.name: description

fields.help_en:
The identifier of the rule template. Cloud Config automatically creates a rule based on the rule template identifier and adds the rule to the current compliance package.

Specify either `ManagedRuleIdentifier` or `ConfigRuleId`. If both parameters are set, `ConfigRuleId` takes precedence. For information about how to obtain the managed rule identifier, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/261176.html
fields.help_zh:
规则模板标识。配置审计根据规则模板标识自动创建规则，并将该规则加入到当前合规包中。

`ManagedRuleIdentifier`和`ConfigRuleId`二选一，当两个参数都设置时，以`ConfigRuleId`为准确。关于如何获取托管规则标识，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/261176.html
fields.name: managed_rule_identifier

fields.help_en:
The risk level of the rule. Valid values:

1: High risk.
2: Medium risk.
3: Low risk
fields.help_zh:
规则风险等级。取值：

1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险
fields.name: risk_level

parameters.help_en:
The list of rules in the compliance package.

When you modify a compliance package, if the rule list is empty, the existing rule list remains unchanged. If the rule list is not empty, the new rules replace the existing rules in the rule list
parameters.help_zh:
合规包中的规则列表。

当您修改合规包时，如果规则列表为空，则保持原有规则列表不变；如果规则列表不为空，则使用新规则替换原有规则列表中的规则
parameters.name: config_rules

parameters.help_en: Ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。`ClientToken`只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The account group ID.

For information about how to obtain the account group ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the compliance package.

For information about how to obtain the compliance package name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包名称。

关于如何获取合规包名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_name

parameters.help_en: The compliance package takes effect only on resources in the specified region IDs. Separate multiple region IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 合规包仅对指定地域ID中的资源生效。多个地域ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: region_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The rule does not take effect on resources in the specified regions. Resources in those regions are not evaluated. Separate multiple region IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 规则对指定地域内资源无效，即不对该地域内资源执行评估。多个地域ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: exclude_region_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The compliance package does not take effect on the specified resource IDs. Resources with those IDs are not evaluated. Separate multiple resource IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 合规包对指定资源ID无效，即不对该资源执行评估。多个资源ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: exclude_resource_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The rule takes effect only on the specified resource IDs. Separate multiple resource IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 规则对指定资源ID生效。多个资源ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The compliance package takes effect only on resources in the specified resource group IDs. Separate multiple resource group IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 合规包仅对指定资源组ID中的资源生效。多个资源组ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_group_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The rule does not take effect on resources in the specified resource group IDs. Resources in those resource groups are not evaluated. Separate multiple resource group IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 规则对指定资源组ID中的资源无效，即不对该资源组内的资源评估。多个资源组ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: exclude_resource_group_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The compliance package takes effect only on resources that are bound with the specified tag key
parameters.help_zh: 合规包仅对绑定指定标签键的资源生效
parameters.name: tag_key_scope

parameters.help_en:
The compliance package takes effect only on resources that are bound with the specified tag key-value pair.
TagValueScope must be used together with TagKeyScope
parameters.help_zh:
合规包仅对绑定指定标签键值对的资源生效。
TagValueScope需结合TagKeyScope一起使用
parameters.name: tag_value_scope

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.

A maximum of 20 tag keys can be bound
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

最多支持绑定20个标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource.

A maximum of 20 tag values can be bound
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

最多支持绑定20个标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tags of the resource. This parameter is deprecated. Ignore this parameter because any value passed in does not take effect.

A maximum of 20 tags can be bound
parameters.help_zh:
资源的标签。该入参已弃用，请忽略，传入不会生效。

最多支持绑定20个标签
parameters.name: tag
